console.name: Commodore 64
console.description: The Commodore 64 is an 8-bit micro computer and successor to the VIC-20. It holds the record of being the highest selling computer model of all time with between 12.5 and 17 million units sold between August 1982 and April 1994. The computer outsold all competitors in the US, was the second most sold computer in the UK, but failed to get a foothold in Japan and France.
